compliance-theater.description: Default Compliance Theater MCP tools for general compliance reasoning. Tools are exposed with the compliance-theater_ prefix, such as compliance-theater_sequentialthinking.
compliance-theater.server_description: Default Compliance Theater MCP tools for general compliance reasoning. Tool search names include compliance-theater_sequentialthinking.

compliance-theater-memory.description: Compliance Theater memory tools for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and relating persisted memories. Tools use the compliance-theater-memory_ prefix.
compliance-theater-memory.server_description: Compliance Theater memory tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-memory_list, compliance-theater-memory_insert, compliance-theater-memory_get, compliance-theater-memory_update, compliance-theater-memory_search, and compliance-theater-memory_related.

compliance-theater-utils.description: Compliance Theater utility tools for authenticated app API calls, auth status/login/cache management, and listing abilities or resources. Tools use the compliance-theater-utils_ prefix.
compliance-theater-utils.server_description: Compliance Theater utility tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-utils_call_api, compliance-theater-utils_list, and compliance-theater-utils_auth.

compliance-theater-todo.description: Compliance Theater todo tools for creating, reading, updating, and advancing compliance-oriented task lists. Tools use the compliance-theater-todo_ prefix.
compliance-theater-todo.server_description: Compliance Theater todo tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-todo_insert, compliance-theater-todo_get, compliance-theater-todo_update, and compliance-theater-todo_toggle.

compliance-theater-case-workspace.description: Compliance Theater case workspace tools for summaries, workspace files, tasks, document summaries, open questions, session logs, and compaction. Tools use the compliance-theater-case-workspace_ prefix.
compliance-theater-case-workspace.server_description: Compliance Theater case workspace tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-case-workspace_get, compliance-theater-case-workspace_read, compliance-theater-case-workspace_append_task, compliance-theater-case-workspace_update_status, compliance-theater-case-workspace_upsert, and compliance-theater-case-workspace_compact.

compliance-theater-search.description: Compliance Theater search tools for policy search, case-file evidence search, case-file document indexes, embeddings, and Neo4j graph queries. Tools use the compliance-theater-search_ prefix.
compliance-theater-search.server_description: Compliance Theater search tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-search_policy, compliance-theater-search_case_file, compliance-theater-search_index, compliance-theater-search_embed, compliance-theater-search_graph_schema, compliance-theater-search_graph_read, and compliance-theater-search_graph_write.

compliance-theater-case-files.description: Compliance Theater case-file tools for direct full-fidelity reads, goal-based case-file retrieval, and amendments to structured case-file document details. Tools use the compliance-theater-case-files_ prefix.
compliance-theater-case-files.server_description: Compliance Theater case-file tools. Tool search names include compliance-theater-case-files_get for direct caseFileId reads and goals-mode retrieval, plus compliance-theater-case-files_amend for case-file amendments.
